theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (a b : ℝ), LipschitzWith L f → a < b → ∃ (hs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (hs k)) ∧ (∀ k x, ‖fderiv ℝ (hs k) x‖ ≤ c) ∧ (∀ k x, |hs k x| ≤ 2) ∧ TendstoUniformly hs (fun x => min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a)))) atTop
